Before this
happened, I lived a
calm life. If it had
never happened, I
would have gone on
living that calm,
even slightly dull
life. But in the end
it did happen - just
now, when I pressed
the button and
switched on the
space-time transfer
device of the
Heroes' Altar of the
ancient continent.
When I came to from
the mighty force
field of twisted
space-time, I was
already in this
mysterious land of
legend. There's no
telling what era it
is. I seem to have
landed west of the
Central Plains, in a
town neither big nor
small. The streets
are busy and fairly
lively. From
people's chatter I
learned the place is
called "Safehaven",
and when I looked at
myself, I found I
had become a
fourteen-year-old
boy! What secrets
does this place
hold? Is it a
furnace that forges
heroes, or fertile
soil for demons? I
don't know. All I
know is that from
now on, my life will
never be the same.
